text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"“The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high...”","quality":"textual integration","description":"It incorporates a relevant quotation and ties it into the argument, showing stronger ability to use source-like material effectively."},{"evidence":"“When I was 11 years old and I used to play soccer...”","quality":"specific supporting example","description":"It develops ideas with a more concrete personal anecdote rather than repeating general statements."},{"evidence":"“Another reason, when we make our goals... we discover new things”","quality":"idea development","description":"It explains consequences of the claim with more elaboration and cause-and-effect reasoning."},{"evidence":"“However, copmplete a challenging goals make us proud of ourselves...”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges an opposing view and responds to it, which adds argumentative sophistication."},{"evidence":"“we feel better knowing that we did our best”","quality":"organization","description":"Its body paragraphs are more clearly organized around reasons and transitions, giving the essay a stronger overall structure."},{"evidence":"“proffesional”, “confindent”, “succsesful”","quality":"spelling control","description":"It has fewer and less disruptive spelling problems than the other essay, which helps readability."},{"evidence":"“we are people who worked really hard and we discover many things”","quality":"sentence variety","description":"It shows somewhat more varied sentence forms and combines ideas more flexibly than the more repetitive essay."}]}
